title: 真实posix_fallocate预分配：区分逻辑扩展和已分配块，保留已有目标
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 预分配通常实际预留块以降低后续空间不足风险；truncate 增大逻辑长度常产生空洞而不立即分配全部块。
文件系统支持和模式会影响行为。
预分配不代表内容已写入或应用数据完整。

conversion.original_title: fallocate 预分配与 truncate 扩展文件有什么区别？

body:
## 操作任务
实现allocate(path,size)。size必须为正整数且不接受bool；独占新建文件，用os.posix_fallocate(fd,0,size)预分配，关闭fd；分配失败清理自己新建的文件并传播异常。已有目标不得覆盖。实际tmpfs中同长度truncate对照为稀疏洞，目标st_size精确且st_blocks*512覆盖请求长度，读出为零；不能把零内容误称业务数据完整，不证明物理介质持久化。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
非root隔离Linux临时文件系统，实际系统调用、stat、内容与写传播验证；不是块设备故障/掉电测试，不改宿主挂载或权限；辅助检查不单计。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,tempfile,pathlib,hashlib,stat
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
from task import allocate
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-allocation-') as folder:
 root=pathlib.Path(folder);size=4*1024*1024+123;control=root/'truncate-control'
 with control.open('wb') as stream:stream.truncate(size)
 sparse=control.stat();assert sparse.st_size==size and sparse.st_blocks*512<size//8,'fixture filesystem must support sparse truncate'
 for index,length in enumerate((size,8193)):
  path=root/('allocated-'+str(index));allocate(path,length);info=path.stat()
  assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_size==length and info.st_blocks*512>=length,'logical extension is not full preallocation'
  with path.open('rb') as stream:
   while True:
    chunk=stream.read(65536)
    if not chunk:break
    assert chunk==bytes(len(chunk)),'allocation must not claim application payload already written'
  before=(info.st_ino,info.st_size,info.st_blocks,hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
  try:allocate(path,length*2)
  except FileExistsError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('existing destination must not be overwritten')
  now=path.stat();assert before==(now.st_ino,now.st_size,now.st_blocks,hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 for invalid in (0,-1,True,1.5):
  path=root/'invalid'
  try:allocate(path,invalid)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid size accepted')
  assert not path.exists()
 assert control.stat().st_blocks==sparse.st_blocks and control.stat().st_size==size
 print('NATIVE_POSIX_FALLOCATE_ALLOCATED_BLOCKS_VS_TRUNCATE_HOLE_EXACT_LENGTH_ZERO_CONTENT_EXISTING_FILE_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实目录恢复的硬链接拓扑：保持inode分组，不能按内容哈希合并文件
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 若工具把多个硬链接复制成多个独立文件，内容哈希仍相同但空间、更新传播和应用语义改变。
应按设备/inode分组核对源关系与目标链接数，同时验证ACL/xattr和稀疏性。
内容校验只是迁移验收的一部分。

conversion.original_title: 大规模目录迁移为何还要比较硬链接拓扑？

body:
## 操作任务
实现clone_tree(source,destination)。源是已稳定的自有目录，目的必须不存在。先完整扫描，只允许普通文件与目录，遇符号链接或其他类型在创建目的前ValueError。复制所有目录、隐藏文件和内容，以源(st_dev,st_ino)分组，在新目的内用硬链接保持同一组；源中内容相同但inode不同的文件必须保持独立。不能让目的与源共享inode，源树外硬链接不纳入目的。已有目的拒绝覆盖。不要求ACL、xattr、稀疏性或并发源快照一致性，这些不能仅凭本题通过推断。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
非root隔离Linux临时文件系统，实际系统调用、stat、内容与写传播验证；不是块设备故障/掉电测试，不改宿主挂载或权限；辅助检查不单计。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,tempfile,pathlib,hashlib,stat
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
from task import clone_tree
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-topology-') as folder:
 root=pathlib.Path(folder);source=root/'source';source.mkdir();(source/'nested').mkdir();(source/'nested'/'空 目录').mkdir();payload=os.urandom(8192)
 (source/'a').write_bytes(payload);os.link(source/'a',source/'nested'/'a alias');os.link(source/'a',root/'external-link')
 (source/'same-content-independent').write_bytes(payload)
 (source/'nested'/'b').write_bytes(b'separate group');os.link(source/'nested'/'b',source/'b alias');os.link(source/'nested'/'b',source/'nested'/'空 目录'/'b alias')
 (source/'.hidden').write_bytes(b'hidden-content')
 def snapshot(tree):
  return {str(path.relative_to(tree)):(path.stat().st_dev,path.stat().st_ino,path.stat().st_nlink,path.read_bytes()) for path in tree.rglob('*') if path.is_file()}
 before=snapshot(source);destination=root/'restored';clone_tree(source,destination);after=snapshot(destination)
 assert set(before)==set(after) and (destination/'nested'/'空 目录').is_dir()
 for left in before:
  assert before[left][3]==after[left][3] and before[left][:2]!=after[left][:2],'restored files must be independent from source'
  for right in before:
   assert (before[left][:2]==before[right][:2])==(after[left][:2]==after[right][:2]),'lost hard-link relationship or deduplicated unrelated equal-content files'
 for name,info in after.items():assert info[2]==sum(other[:2]==info[:2] for other in after.values()),'external source links must not leak into restored topology'
 assert snapshot(source)==before and (root/'external-link').read_bytes()==payload
 (destination/'a').write_bytes(b'changed restored group');assert (destination/'nested'/'a alias').read_bytes()==b'changed restored group' and (destination/'same-content-independent').read_bytes()==payload and snapshot(source)==before
 try:clone_tree(source,destination)
 except FileExistsError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('existing restoration directory must not be overwritten')
 bad=root/'bad';bad.mkdir();(bad/'escape').symlink_to(source/'a');rejected=root/'rejected'
 try:clone_tree(bad,rejected)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('symlink must be rejected before destination publication')
 assert not rejected.exists() and snapshot(source)==before
 print('NATIVE_TREE_COPY_PRESERVES_INODE_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_HASH_EQUALITY_EXTERNAL_LINK_EXCLUDED_NEW_INODES_AND_WRITE_PROPAGATION',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
